Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
On Aug 16, 1:20 pm, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Can one force a vampire with no  votes to tap from under the skin?

Yes.

Under the Skin
Cardtype:	Action Modifier
Discipline:	Auspex & Presence
Only usable during a referendum before votes are cast.
[aus][pre] Choose a younger vampire. That vampire abstains from
voting.
[AUS][PRE] As above, and tap that vampire at the end of the action if
the referendum passes.
